question.text: Which institution was the first financial institution (not a bank) to set up a merchant banking division in India?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the NISM-Series-IX Merchant Banking workbook (p.22), ICICI was the first financial institution to set up a merchant banking division in India, in 1973. SBI (a bank) had set up its division in 1972, so ICICI was first among non-bank financial institutions. The Trap: IDBI is another major development financial institution but set up its merchant banking division in 1992 (p.23), much later than ICICI. SBI is a bank, not a financial institution in this categorization. NABARD is not cited as an early merchant banking entrant in the workbook. Note: Anchor the timeline to pp.22-23: SBI 1972 (bank), ICICI 1973 (first FI), IDBI 1992.
